opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases are comprehensive, well-structured, and adequately cover the distinct scenarios, edge cases, and risk areas for the given requirements. No blockers were identified.

All test cases map correctly to the specified requirements, but several cases (G-002, G-003, G-007, G-013, G-019, G-023, G-026) test edge cases, error conditions, or features like Private Browsing that are not supported or defined in the provided requirements list (R-073 to R-084). These unsupported boundary conditions make those specific cases untestable against the given requirement set.
confirmed_blockers: G-002 introduces a malformed URL test which is unsupported by R-073.
G-003 tests Private Browsing mode history exclusion, which is not mentioned in R-073.
G-007 tests dead or blocked links error handling, which is not specified in R-075.
G-013 tests clearing an already empty history, not defined in R-078.
G-019 tests min/max column resizing limits, which are not detailed in R-081.
G-023 tests disabled states for empty back/forward dropdowns, not covered by R-083.
G-026 tests file permission errors for session history creation, which is not specified in R-084.

confirmed_blockers: G-002 introduces a malformed URL test which is unsupported by R-073.
G-003 tests Private Browsing mode history exclusion, which is not mentioned in R-073.
G-007 tests dead or blocked links error handling, which is not specified in R-075.
G-013 tests clearing an already empty history, not defined in R-078.
G-019 tests min/max column resizing limits, which are not detailed in R-081.
G-023 tests disabled states for empty back/forward dropdowns, not covered by R-083.
G-026 tests file permission errors for session history creation, which is not specified in R-084.

output.analysis: Unit: firefox_browser_history. R-073: Normal scenario records standard visited links to Global History; actionable missing scenario includes validating recording behavior for unique valid URL protocols. R-074: Normal scenario records the final redirected URL after a server redirect; actionable missing scenario handles single-hop vs multi-hop redirection chains. R-075: Normal scenario launches clicked history link in a browser window; actionable missing scenario verifies link launching from different view grouping modes (Day/Site/None). R-076: Normal scenario deletes a single history entry; actionable missing scenario ensures dependent UI lists update correctly upon deletion. R-077: Normal scenario deletes multiple selected entries and removes them from display; actionable missing scenario verifies batch deletion performance and non-contiguous selection removal. R-078: Normal scenario clears entire Global History; actionable missing scenario confirms persistence across application restarts following a clear action. R-079: Normal scenario groups history items by Day, Site, and None; actionable missing scenario verifies grouping behavior with mixed timezone timestamps and special character site names. R-080: Normal scenario sorts and reverse-sorts per column; actionable missing scenario tests sorting stability with identical timestamps or titles. R-081: Normal scenario resizes history columns to show and hide more entries; actionable missing scenario verifies column width state persistence across UI reopens. R-082: Normal scenario shows and hides history columns via UI toggles; actionable missing scenario checks layout integrity when all optional columns are hidden simultaneously. R-083: Normal scenario accesses recently visited sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menus; actionable missing scenario validates dropdown navigation correctness after session restoration. R-084: Normal scenario creates a new, empty session history file for a new browser window or a restart; actionable missing scenario verifies file initialization when previous session files are missing or corrupted.
